meta.name: baoyu-compress-image
meta.description: Compresses images to WebP (default) or PNG with automatic tool selection. Use when user asks to "compress image", "optimize image", "convert to webp", or reduce image file size.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩图片为 WebP 或 PNG 格式，减小文件体积
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要压缩图片或转换格式来节省空间
copy.tagline_en: Compress images to WebP or PNG to reduce file size
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compress images or convert formats to save space

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以压缩图片为 WebP（默认）或 PNG 格式，自动选择最佳工具（sips、cwebp、ImageMagick、Sharp），并支持设置质量、保留原图、递归处理目录等。
howto.when: 当你要求“压缩图片”、“优化图片”、“转换为 webp”或“减小图片文件大小”时触发。

say.text: 把这张图片压缩成 WebP 格式，质量 80。
say.note: Claude 会调用工具压缩图片。

say.text: 把这个文件夹里的所有图片都压缩成 PNG，保留原图。
say.note: Claude 会递归处理目录并保留原文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can compress images to WebP (default) or PNG, automatically selecting the best tool (sips, cwebp, ImageMagick, Sharp), with options for quality, keep original, recursive directory processing, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "compress image", "optimize image", "convert to webp", or reduce image file size.

say_en.text: Compress this image to WebP with quality 80.
say_en.note: Claude will run the compression tool.

say_en.text: Compress all images in this folder to PNG, keep originals.
say_en.note: Claude will process recursively and keep original files.
